description: This Java class implements an HTML Tree Renderer as part of Apache OFBiz's widget rendering system. It handles the rendering of tree structures in HTML, including nodes, links, labels, and images, with support for expandable/collapsible nodes and integration with OFBiz's URL and request handling.

classes.name: HtmlTreeRenderer
classes.description: An implementation of a Tree String Renderer that outputs HTML for a tree structure in OFBiz, supporting expandable nodes, labels, links, and images. It manages the rendering of individual tree nodes, handling the attributes and expansion/collapse logic.

methods.name: renderNodeBegin
methods.description: Renders the beginning of a tree node, including opening HTML tags and expansion/collapse controls.

methods.name: renderNodeEnd
methods.description: Closes HTML tags after rendering a tree node, including closing lists and optional boundary comments.

methods.name: renderLastElement
methods.description: Renders the last element of a node, typically starting a new list if needed.

methods.name: renderLabel
methods.description: Renders a label span for a tree node, including id and style attributes.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Renders a hyperlink for a tree node, including handling URL modes, target attributes, and embedded images.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Renders an image tag with appropriate attributes and URL resolution based on context.

methods.name: getScreenStringRenderer
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the ScreenStringRenderer based on the current context, using MacroScreenRenderer if necessary.
